cohort: Primiparous adolescents (younger than 19 years of age and with less than 20 weeks of gestational age)
finding: BMI classification according to the Child Growth Standards (CGS) differed from WHO and gynaecological age (GA), however CGS and WHO agreed on perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Inadequate GWG was observed in 72·2 % of cases and was correlated with a higher rate of caesarean birth.
